articles.headline: Hagan, Basketball Hall of Famer and Kentucky legend, dies at 94
articles.description: Hall of Fame forward Cliff Hagan, a five-time All-Star who spent his entire NBA career with the St. Louis Hawks, has died at age 94.

images.name: Cliff Hagan [600x400]
images.caption: Cliff Hagan, shown here defending Wilt Chamberlain in a 1959 game between the Hawks and 76ers, was involved in a famous trade that gave the Celtics the right to draft Bill Russell.

articles.headline: NCAA sues Ohio gov. over order allowing schools to ignore new eligibility rule
articles.description: The NCAA has filed a federal lawsuit against Ohio Gov. Mike DeWine three days after he signed an executive order giving the state's colleges and universities the option of allowing athletes who graduated from high school in 2022 to play a fifth year.

articles.headline: Las Vegas bettor Shane Hennen pleads guilty to charges related to fixing schemes
articles.description: A bettor indicted in three federal gambling cases pleaded guilty to charges related to schemes involving the NBA, NCAA and Chinese Basketball Association.
